en: Illustrated historical scene showing a mounted officer in early‑modern military dress riding a horse in the foreground during a coastal siege. Soldiers and an officer with a map stand nearby, cannon fire and ships appear in the background near a fortified town by the sea. At the bottom is a printed caption in French referring to the reign of Albert and Isabella and the Siege of Ostend (1601‑1604), plus an advertisement for Liebig products. A facsimile signature 'J. Liebig' is visible on the right.
